additionalProperties.comment: Feeds ordinary input bytes, encoding them for the software 64-byte block path. SHA-1 with flag 0x100 can switch to a backend that stages 0x1000-byte chunks. Returns zero on success or backend error; null input returns bytes and zero length returns zero. May change backend ownership and state flags.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DigestUpdatePlain
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_DigestUpdatePlain(byte * input, uint bytes, OSOS_FairPlayDigest * state)

additionalProperties.comment: Searches registry at 089d3678 with record stride 0xb8 for an encoded handle match. Routes the selected record through FairPlay_RefreshStorageRecord with a transformed refresh_selector; returns the record pointer or null on lookup/refresh failure. This lookup can perform disk I/O through refresh. Selector encoding and complete handle-validation rules remain unresolved.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ResolveStorageHandle

additionalProperties.comment: Sets context tag at +0, clears scratch pointer +4 and allocates AES scratch there. On scratch failure destroys the whole context through FairPlay_DestroyDecryptionContext. Returns mapped allocation status; callers must not reuse context after failure.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_AttachContextAESScratch

additionalProperties.comment: Rejects borrowed/read-only backing flags, inserts a child and converts input bytes into record encoding with x*0x8b. Copy direction follows source/destination order. Optionally writes new record offset and returns status. Caller must keep source valid across possible backing resize.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_InsertRecordEncodedPayload
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_InsertRecordEncodedPayload(uint bytes, uint parent_offset, byte * encoded_input, uint key_a, uint ordinal, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint * record_offset, uint key_b)

additionalProperties.comment: Returns one when selector is 0, 1 or 2, otherwise zero. The two internal multipliers cancel modulo 2^32, so the external selector is plain. Pure predicate; no memory writes.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_IsSmallSelector

additionalProperties.comment: Uses the record descriptor at object+0 to find root divi/keyB=1. Reads its first big-endian payload word; a missing divi writes zero. Requires object and output, returns status, and does not create the optional record.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ReadOptionalDivi

additionalProperties.comment: Validates a scalar record, decodes payload bytes with multiplier 0x17 and copies in overlap-aware direction. Requires payload length <=capacity, or exact length when allow_larger_capacity=0. Optionally publishes an encoded copied-length word. Returns status; a zero capacity permits null output only for an empty payload.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_CopyRecordPayloadPlain
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_CopyRecordPayloadPlain(uint offset, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint * encoded_bytes, byte * output, uint capacity, int allow_larger_capacity)

additionalProperties.comment: Validates a leaf record and copies its payload using x*0x1b-0x14 byte encoding. Requires payload <= capacity, or exact equality when allow_larger_capacity=0. Optional encoded_bytes receives payload size * 0xbd7d7cff. Returns zero or descriptor/record/size error; supports either copy direction.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_CopyRecordPayloadEncoded
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_CopyRecordPayloadEncoded(uint * encoded_bytes, uint capacity, OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, int allow_larger_capacity, byte * output, uint record_offset)

additionalProperties.comment: Exports magnitude as fixed-width big-endian bytes multiplied by 0xe9, with leading zero padding. Returns without writing if output_bytes is smaller than abs(decoded limb count)*4. Ignores sign and does not return a status.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntExportE9
additionalProperties.value: void FairPlay_BigIntExportE9(uint output_bytes, byte * output, uint * value)

additionalProperties.comment: Validates an encoded record and returns its offset, or zero on failure. Offset zero means root at 12. Decodes big-endian size (minimum 20), checks end bounds/overflow and, when child count at +14 is nonzero, walks exactly that many nested records and requires their lengths to fill the parent. Internal bytes decode by multiplication by 0x17.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ValidateRecordOffset

additionalProperties.comment: Tests the decoded type against 50, 51, 60, 61, 70 and 80; returns plain 0/1. Used by verification-object construction/processing. Pure predicate; the higher-level meanings of these numeric types remain unresolved.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_IsVerificationType

additionalProperties.comment: Walks ordinary big-endian child atoms starting at sinf+8, checking minimum size and end bounds. Captures frma as a native format word, sign/schi payload offsets and sizes, and three skcr words; marks schm presence. Success requires exact end and flags frma|schm|schi (0x0b). Caller initializes info; duplicate recognized atoms overwrite prior fields.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ParseSinfChildren
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ParseSinfChildren(byte * sinf, uint bytes, OSOS_FairPlaySinfInfo * info)

additionalProperties.comment: Initializes SHA-1 mode, digests two decoded 32-bit prefixes in first-prefix then second-prefix order, then the encoded input payload and finalizes to a 20-byte encoded digest. Checks input/output pointers. Returns zero on the completed path; intermediate digest statuses are not checked.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DigestPrefixedPayload
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_DigestPrefixedPayload(uint encoded_second_prefix, byte * encoded_digest20, uint encoded_first_prefix, uint encoded_bytes, byte * encoded_input)

additionalProperties.comment: Checks an encoded context tag, releases nonnull scratch object at +4 through 082a8c98, overwrites the 0x50-byte context through an obfuscated byte loop, then frees it with 08023ef0. Returns a 32-bit status; exact tag/error encoding is unresolved. Outer release wrapper handles null. Overwrite bytes are generated values rather than a simple zero-fill.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DestroyDecryptionContext

additionalProperties.comment: Rejects null descriptor or null backing pointer. If bit 1 of (flags_at_8 * 3) is clear, overwrites the decoded byte count from +4 and frees backing storage at +0. Then overwrites and frees the 12-byte descriptor. Returns zero on cleanup; ownership flags and length are encoded.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_DestroyBufferDescriptor

additionalProperties.comment: Allocates an owned record buffer and converts input bytes with ((byte*0x49)-1)*0xa7. includes_prefix selects a full-buffer copy versus adding a zero 12-byte prefix. Rejects null input and short prefixed data, propagates allocation errors, and publishes the descriptor on success. Caller supplies a valid output pointer.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ImportRecordBuffer
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ImportRecordBuffer(OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * * output, uint input_bytes, int includes_prefix, byte * input)

additionalProperties.comment: Walks ASN.1 elements against 28-byte encoded rules, with a fixed 16-level traversal stack. Supports optional rules, child/next indices, expected-payload comparison and callbacks receiving a 20-byte OSOS_FairPlayASN1Match. Special tag -0x1000000 accepts several ASN.1 string tags. Returns parse/callback status; callbacks may mutate their context. Does not allocate.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ParseASN1Rules
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ParseASN1Rules(OSOS_FairPlayASN1Rule * rules, int repeat_mode, void * callback_context, uint bytes, int rule_count, byte * input)

additionalProperties.comment: Allocates a 0x24-byte sidv/sidl object, decodes its backing through 083055a4, then validates the record tree with maximum depth 3. Copies the 24-byte identity and decoded mode into the object on success. On failure destroys the descriptor, wipes/frees the object and returns status.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ParseSidvOrSidlObject
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ParseSidvOrSidlObject(uint encoded_bytes, byte * input, byte * identity24, void * * output, uint encoded_mode)

additionalProperties.comment: Validates parent and walks nested records in its payload, comparing decoded header key A/B. Returns matching child offset or zero; optional ordinal is one-based. Traversal relies on the parent validation and encoded record lengths.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_FindChildRecord
additionalProperties.value: uint FairPlay_FindChildRecord(OSOS_FairPlayBufferDescriptor * descriptor, uint key_b, uint parent_offset, ushort * ordinal, uint key_a)

additionalProperties.comment: Computes base^exponent mod modulus for encoded integers. Converts base into Montgomery form, scans exponent bits from most to least significant with square/conditional multiply, converts out and copies to output. Uses two fixed 524-byte stack workspaces; caller initializes mont and supplies valid sizes.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntModExp
additionalProperties.value: void FairPlay_BigIntModExp(OSOS_FairPlayMontgomery * mont, uint * modulus, uint * base, uint * exponent, uint * output)

additionalProperties.comment: Initializes HMAC with an internally encoded key. Keys longer than 64 bytes are hashed first; prepares encoded inner/outer pads using XOR 0x36/0x5c, stores outer pad at +0x68 and feeds the 64-byte inner pad. Null or zero-length key returns without initializing state. sidr callers use a 24-byte encoded key and mode 2 (SHA-1).
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_HmacInitEncodedKey
additionalProperties.value: void FairPlay_HmacInitEncodedKey(uint key_bytes, OSOS_FairPlayHmac * state, byte * encoded_key, uint mode_flags)

additionalProperties.comment: Shifts encoded integer magnitude left in place by whole limbs and remaining bits, preserving sign, filling low limbs with zero and updating encoded count. Caller supplies enough capacity. Shared tail target of BigIntShift; argument order is bits then value.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_BigIntShiftLeft

additionalProperties.comment: Validates the user-ID argument and requires sidr version at +0x2c to equal 0x10000, then dispatches to ApplySidrRightsFromSidv with decoded/re-encoded scalar arguments. Returns mapped argument/version/processing status. Caller provides a valid sidr pointer.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ApplySidrRightsV1
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ApplySidrRightsV1(void * sidv_or_sidl, uint encoded_rights_id, void * operation_context, void * sidr, uint encoded_user_id)

additionalProperties.comment: Writes 0 to WDTCON (0x3c800000), then 0x0aa5 to SWRCON (0x3c500050) to request a software reset. Spins forever if reset has not yet occurred.
additionalProperties.name: ResetSocAndWait

additionalProperties.comment: Calls locked hardware AES using input=scratch+4 pointer, output=scratch+8 pointer, supplied key/IV, selector 0 and a fixed length of 0x1000 bytes. Returns 0 on hardware status 0, otherwise 0xffff5b32. Caller 0831d894 also places a byte count on the stack, but this wrapper never reads it; both scratch buffers must hold a full page.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_ProcessAESScratchPage
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_ProcessAESScratchPage(void * scratch, uint direction, byte * key, byte * iv)

additionalProperties.comment: Copies bytes sequentially to state+0 when both pointers are nonnull; returns zero after copying or 9 for a null pointer. Used by SHA feed for 0..63 trailing bytes. No local length/capacity check; caller must supply a nonnegative count fitting the partial block.
additionalProperties.name: Crypto_SHA1StorePartialBlock
additionalProperties.value: int Crypto_SHA1StorePartialBlock(OSOS_SHA1BackendState * state, byte * input, int bytes)

additionalProperties.comment: Returns the cached pointer to the imported 0x120-byte SysInfo at 0x08a1a330; initializes the pointer on first use.
additionalProperties.name: Platform_GetImportedSysInfo

additionalProperties.comment: Reads the boot-info record at offset 0x18. Requires SysI magic, then copies 0x120 bytes from its pointer into 0x08a1a330. Returns 0 on success or 0x52 for invalid magic.
additionalProperties.name: Platform_ImportBootSysInfo

additionalProperties.comment: Configures timer E with ECLK input, prescaler 11, maximum reload, and clear/enable command. At the Classic 12 MHz ECLK this produces the 1 MHz counter read by Platform_ReadFrameClock.
additionalProperties.name: Platform_InitMicrosecondCounter

additionalProperties.comment: Writes enabled != 0 to PMU LEDENA register 0x29 through the locking PMU write wrapper. Does not change brightness or power-rail registers. Not panic-safe.
additionalProperties.name: PMU_SetBacklightEnabled

additionalProperties.comment: Queries the prior resource-gate state for mask (0,1), enables that resource and clears control at MMIO 0x3c100000. Returns the previous gate-state token for RestoreHardware. Does not itself read a random word or acquire a mutex.
additionalProperties.name: CryptoRandom_PrepareHardware

additionalProperties.comment: Polls MMIO 0x3c100000 until status bits 0..2 are nonzero, then returns the word at +4. Assumes hardware has been prepared. Has no timeout, error return or allocation.
additionalProperties.name: CryptoRandom_ReadWordBlocking

additionalProperties.comment: Native thunk to the NUL-terminated byte-string comparator; zero means equal.
additionalProperties.name: String_CompareCString

additionalProperties.comment: Compares NUL-terminated byte strings lexicographically as unsigned bytes; returns -1, 0 or 1.
additionalProperties.name: String_CompareCStringImpl

additionalProperties.comment: Startup hardware gate: reads imported HwVr and requires Classic revision >= 0x0300. Failure writes the softupdt warm-boot tag then resets the SoC. Success writes diskmode and continues initialization. Entered via IRAM thunk 0x220036c8.
additionalProperties.name: InitializeHardwareCheckedStartup

additionalProperties.comment: Constructs and registers the Hold switch debounce task object, enters the native task wait, then destroys the task object on return.
additionalProperties.name: HoldSwitch_RunTask

additionalProperties.comment: Walks the format string and ARM variadic argument words, emitting text through semihosting. Supports decimal, unsigned, hex, character, string and percent conversions with limited width handling. Literal spans are temporarily NUL-terminated by Semihost_WriteSpan, so format must be writable.
additionalProperties.name: Semihost_DebugVPrintf

additionalProperties.comment: Null returns -50; an already-set byte 0 returns 0. Otherwise checks embedded path+4 using storage mode +0xc: an existing path returns 0xffff5b81; an absent path sets byte 0 and returns 0xffff5b80. This is a state/status query, not a simple exists boolean.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_CheckStoragePathState

additionalProperties.comment: Checks buffered length <0x1000 and internal digest pointer, processes pending data without final padding, then exports the 64-byte partial block, counters and five byte-reversed chaining words. Clears workspace, releases backing and frees wrapper on success. Returns status; caller must clear its backend reference.
additionalProperties.name: FairPlay_SHA1ExportAndReleaseBackend
additionalProperties.value: int FairPlay_SHA1ExportAndReleaseBackend(OSOS_CryptoAlignedBuffer * backend, byte * partial_block, uint * bytes_low, uint * bytes_high, uint * state_words)

additionalProperties.comment: Decrements the shared control-block count. The last reference deletes the model through vtable +0x1c, releases its optional lock and frees the block. Clears the reference.
additionalProperties.name: LibraryModelRef_Release

additionalProperties.comment: Initializes a shared model reference. A nonnull model gets a 12-byte control block with count 1; synchronized creates an additional lock. The last reference deletes the model through vtable +0x1c.
additionalProperties.name: LibraryModelRef_Init
additionalProperties.value: void * __stdcall LibraryModelRef_Init(void * reference, void * model, int synchronized)

additionalProperties.comment: Releases the destination and copies the source control block with a retained count; self-assignment is unchanged. Returns destination.
additionalProperties.name: LibraryModelRef_Assign

additionalProperties.comment: Activates the base controller, resolves selection and adds the UI observer. Uses slot +0x124 to present the requested layout at +0xe0. Screen definition is at +0xb0.
additionalProperties.name: ResourceScreen_Activate

additionalProperties.comment: Removes the UI observer, deactivates the base controller and restores transition state from +0xe6 when leaving. Returns the base deactivate result.
additionalProperties.name: ResourceScreen_Deactivate

additionalProperties.comment: Removes the UI observer, deactivates the Brightness controller and restores saved transition state when leaving. Returns the underlying deactivate result.
additionalProperties.name: BrightnessScreen_Deactivate

additionalProperties.comment: Allocates or reuses a 0x28-byte event-map tree node. Pool growth starts at 32 nodes (0x500 bytes) plus a 12-byte chunk record, then grows by at least 32 nodes.
additionalProperties.name: UIEventMap_AllocateNode

additionalProperties.comment: Copies a key/binding pair into a new map node, sharing native string storage where permitted. Reserves max(32, action_count) 16-byte action slots even for an empty action vector.
additionalProperties.name: UIEventMap_CloneNode

additionalProperties.comment: Clears destination entries and recursively clones source tree nodes and bindings. Copies the element count and returns destination; does nothing on self-assignment.
additionalProperties.name: UIEventMap_Assign
BlockList_Erase

additionalProperties.name: LibraryModelRef_Get

additionalProperties.name: CppString_Destroy

additionalProperties.comment: Constructs the one-pointer C++ string from null-terminated text, copying nonempty text into owned storage. Returns the string object.

additionalProperties.comment: Finds or inserts a C++ string key in the resource-name map and returns its numeric ID slot.

additionalProperties.name: Startup_CopyImageToRuntimeRegions

Common reset reached from queue rebuild 220072ec, metadata clear 220072b4, and underrun recovery 22007280. Called around decoder repositioning in 220054c8 via those reset paths. Synthesized-audio history must be invalidated when these queue positions reset.

additionalProperties.comment: Fills an audio output buffer. When exposure counting is enabled, output route is headphones (0), and volume exceeds the configured threshold, accumulates rendered frames / sample rate as float seconds. At the configured limit (default 72000 seconds), clears the counter and invokes the registered callback.
additionalProperties.name: Audio_FillOutputBuffer
